request.style: English, male rock voice, electric guitar, bass, drums, piano, intense and grateful mood, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I love you LORD my strength
You are my rock and fortress
My God my crag of refuge
My shield and my salvation

[Chorus]
The LORD is my rock my fortress
My deliverer my stronghold
The horn of my salvation
My God my safe place

[Verse]
I call on the LORD worthy of praise
And I am saved from my enemies
You hold me when the world shakes
You keep me from falling

[Chorus]
The LORD is my rock my fortress
My deliverer my stronghold
The horn of my salvation
My God my safe place

[Bridge]
I find my rest in your shadow
Your strength is my daily bread
I sing to the one who rescues me
From the grasp of all my foes

[Outro]
You are my rock forever
My strength and my song
